privacy-policy-heading.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy-heading.subtitle:
This Privacy Policy explains how Walks in Town Srl collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal information when you use our website, contact us, or book tours and travel experiences.

We process personal data in accordance with applicable Italian and European data protection laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

content.title: Information We Collect
content.subtitle: Information You Provide
paragraphs: We may collect information you provide when you make a booking, contact us, subscribe to communications, or use our services.
This may include:

subcontent.title: Information Collected Automatically
paragraphs: When you use our website, we may automatically collect technical information such as your IP address, browser type, device information, visited pages, and website activity.
Payment card details are processed securely by our payment providers and are not stored directly by Walks in Town.

content.title: How We Use Your Information
content.subtitle: Booking and Service Delivery
paragraphs: We use your personal information to:

items: Send confirmations and important service updates

subcontent.title: Business and Legal Purposes
paragraphs: We may also use personal information to prevent fraud, improve our website and services, maintain business records, and comply with legal obligations.
Marketing communications will only be sent where permitted by law or where you have provided consent.

content.title: Legal Basis for Processing
content.subtitle: Why We Are Allowed to Use Your Data
paragraphs: We process personal information under one or more of the following legal grounds:

items: Steps taken before entering into a contract

paragraphs: Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw that consent at any time.

content.title: Sharing Your Information
content.subtitle: Travel and Service Partners
paragraphs: We may share the information required to complete your booking with selected service providers, including:
We do not sell your personal information.

subcontent.title: Legal Disclosures
paragraphs: We may also disclose personal information where required by law, regulation, court order, or a competent public authority.
We only share information that is reasonably necessary for the relevant purpose.

content.title: Data Retention and Security
content.subtitle: How Long We Keep Your Data
paragraphs: We retain personal information only for as long as necessary to provide our services, meet legal and accounting requirements, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements.
Retention periods may vary depending on the type of information and the purpose for which it was collected.

subcontent.title: How We Protect Your Data
paragraphs: Walks in Town uses appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal data against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration, or disclosure.
However, no electronic transmission or storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

content.title: Cookies and Website Data
content.subtitle: How Cookies Are Used
paragraphs: Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to:

items: Support marketing activities, where consent is provided

subcontent.title: Managing Cookie Preferences
paragraphs: Non-essential cookies will only be used where required consent has been obtained.
You can manage or withdraw your cookie preferences through the cookie settings available on the website. Additional information may be provided in our Cookie Policy.

content.title: Your Privacy Rights
content.subtitle: Your Rights Under GDPR
paragraphs: Depending on the circumstances, you may have the right to:

items: Restrict the use of your data

subcontent.title: How to Exercise Your Rights
paragraphs: To submit a privacy request, contact us at info@walkintown.com.
We may ask you to verify your identity before completing the request. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent data protection authority.

content.title: International Data Transfers
paragraphs: Some technology or service providers may process personal information outside the European Economic Area.

Where personal data is transferred internationally, Walks in Town uses appropriate legal safeguards, such as adequacy decisions, standard contractual clauses, or other recognized data protection mechanisms.

content.title: Children’s Privacy
paragraphs: Our services are intended to be booked by adults or by individuals legally authorized to make a booking.
We do not knowingly collect personal information directly from children without appropriate authorization from a parent or legal guardian.
Where information about a minor is required for a booking, it should be provided by the responsible adult.

content.title: Policy Updates
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in our services, website, technology, or legal requirements.
The most recent version will be published on our website with the updated revision date.
